title: Safe Remediation as Risk-Constrained Intervention Decision in Microservice Systems
authors: Dai, Chengxiao; Yan, Zhaokun; Lei, Chenjun; Li, Qiao; Zhang, Luyan
verified_via: arXiv HTML, full text read (method and evaluation)
problem: An incorrect automated repair can cost more than doing nothing; existing systems generate actions rather than decide whether to act
method: Constrained MDP maximising repair success under a bounded false-remediation rate; per-action risk decomposed into blast radius, reversibility and epistemic uncertainty; context-adaptive human-in-the-loop escalation
testbed: Train Ticket microservice benchmark with Chaos Mesh fault injection, 11 fault categories, 8320 decision records from 1664 injected events
key_result: Risk-constrained selection with an interpretable per-action safety interface
limitation: FULL TEXT READ 2026-10-13. Policy learned entirely from logged decision data; candidate actions executed only while the labelled dataset is built, each in an isolated replica after a FULL STATE RESET; at decision time alternatives valued by learned estimators and the escalation gate trained without counterfactual labels. No state-equivalence check between compared branches; variance reported as mean+-sd over 5 seeds without separating environment from training noise.
relation_to_csc: Closest published work on the first two elements. Does NOT execute rejected actions from the decision's own state: a reset replica is not a fork of that state. Row added to Table S1; grounds in supplement S2.

title: OpenTwin: Closed-Loop Digital Twins for Trustworthy Policy Deployment in Open RAN
authors: Zhang, Zifan; Hossen, Md Sharif; Ron, Dara; Shah, Vijay K.; Liu, Yuchen
verified_via: arXiv HTML v2, full text read (method and evaluation)
problem: xApp training and validation risk disrupting a live RAN
method: Closed-loop digital twin with a drift detector and a conformal fidelity gate admitting an action only when its whole calibrated prediction set lies in the safe region
key_result: Distribution-free error budget on each trust decision
limitation: FULL TEXT READ 2026-10-13. Candidates scored in a calibrated forward model and explicitly not on the network; twin not forked from a saved physical state (resync re-infers configuration from recent KPMs and restarts the simulator). Gate updates its radius online and bounds a long-run average false-approval rate, not a finite-sample level on an exchangeable calibration set; under short post-onset windows its reported coverage is 0.843 and 0.852 against a 0.90 target.
relation_to_csc: Closest published use of distribution-free calibration to authorise an action. Also states independently that matching telemetry does not establish configuration recovery, which is this paper's first identifiability limit from the other direction; cited as such in the main text. Row added to Table S1; grounds in supplement S2.
